items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: not because I made the record with him

ctx.x: What about these Englishmen that you've heard play the young guys, what do you think of them as compared with the old times?

You mean those Englishmen coming down here, is that practically the one you're talking about? I had a band from England that King Collier played with, would you be referring to them? Yeah, what about him?
Well I was thinking about King Collier and different guys like that.

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: the record I made with King Collier

ctx.x: Did you make any other records besides that?
Well, the record I made with King Collier, that's about the only records. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
